body_html:
Originally from Mississippi,   John Keith Scott has a passion for music and entertainment.  Starting off DJing for friends and family, John Keith Scott has grown as a DJ and recording artist and wants to have a lasting, positive, and meaningful impact in people’s lives.  “DJing simply allows that opportunity!”  John Keith Scott loves doing Weddings, Corporate Events, Clubs and Lounges!  In his spare time he loves spending time working on performing, going to the gym, photography and time with his 4 sisters!

What’s in John Keith Scott’s Headphones?  R&B, Soul, Hip Hop, Classics & New Age Rock, Pop, Indie, Alternative, Old School, Reggae, etc,.

What are your favorite floor fillers?  Let’s Get It Started, Just Dance, Happy, Shake It off, I Wanna Dance with Somebody, Celebration, etc.
